description: This file defines the AWS IoTSiteWiseClient class, a PHP client for interacting with the AWS IoT SiteWise service. It includes method annotations for various API operations, indicating asynchronous and synchronous methods, and extends the AwsClient base class.

classes.name: Aws\IoTSiteWise\IoTSiteWiseClient
